text:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: autoscaler errors in eu-west-1 -> GPU pool exhaustion and enqueue growth. Severity: P1. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1729876543

Ash L: looking now. queue depth jumped to ~9k across inference pools, 95p latency > 5s.
Marta P: who is on-call for autoscale? @nate?
Nate R: oncall here, pulling controller logs.
Priya S: Support seeing customer reports: tenant-omega returns 502/503. I'm drafting comms.
Kai T: autoscaler controller logs show repeated failures: "CreateInstance failed: quotaExceeded" and provider 429s.
Ash L: confirmed — our scale requests got rejected by provider quota, not our internal limits. We attempted +40 nodes; provider declined.
Nate R: can we failover traffic to reserved/dedicated capacity?
Marta P: reserved pool has limited headroom but we can shift non-critical routes to usa pool.
Support Bot: Support note queued for status page: "We are experiencing capacity constraints in eu-west-1 causing intermittent 502/503 responses for some customers."
Ash L: quick mitigation plan: reduce batch_size for latency-sensitive routes, route lower-priority workloads to CPU fallback, and enable smaller quantized model variants where acceptable.
Priya S: I'll coordinate customer comms. Which tenants are alerted? we currently have alerts for tenant-omega and tenant-beta.
Nate R: implementing temporary route override now: 
```
routes.update("/v1/generate", {
  max_batch_size: 1,
  region_policy: ["eu-west-1","usa-east-1"],
  fallback_model: "redwood-quant-7b"
})
```

Kai T: applying route change. also adding autoscaler tweak: ignore transient 429s for 30s to avoid oscillation.
Ash L: autoscaler stuck in exponential backoff due to repeated CreateInstance errors — manual quota bump required.
Marta P: who can open emergency case with the provider? Kai, can you take this?
Kai T: opened emergency support case #789234 with provider; they acknowledged and provided ETA 20-40m for quota increase.
Nate R: spinning up warm standbys in usa-east-1 and shifting traffic weight to reduce eu queue.
Ash L: started warm standby; queue dropping from ~9k -> 2.8k after partial failover.
Support Bot: status page updated with timeframe and note; monitoring.
Priya S: customer comms sent to tenant-omega, tenant-beta, tenant-gamma (brief outage notice + mitigation steps).
IncBot: incident severity remains P1 (mitigating). Please keep on-call until stable.
Marta P: action items we should track before close:
- Manual provider quota request — Kai (in progress)
- Autoscaler: implement provider-429 backoff & alerting — Nate
- Route fallback automation for quantified smaller-models — Ash
- Postmortem & RCA writeup — Priya
- Update runbook for cross-region warm standby — Marta

Ash L: current operational snapshot for timeline: peak queue 9,200; peak 95p latency 5.8s; affected tenants: 3; mitigation shifted ~40% traffic to usa-east; queue reduced to 2.8k.
Nate R: made temporary batcher changes: batch_window_ms 5 -> 2, max_batch 64 -> 16 to lower per-request latency.
Kai T: provider just confirmed quota increase applied. autoscaler resumed creating instances and pools are scaling. health checks green.
Support Bot: final status update posted: "Capacity restored in eu-west-1. Some customers experienced degraded performance between HH:MM and HH:MM; investigations ongoing."
Priya S: starting the postmortem doc and timeline. Will include customer impact and comms.
Marta P: good work. keep this thread as the canonical incident timeline and attach the postmortem when ready.
Ash L: follow-ups to add to the postmortem: test runbook for quota-failure failover, pre-authorized emergency quota escalation playbook, and automation: trigger cross-region routing when provider 429 rate > 5/min.
Nate R: ack — I'll pair with infra to implement detection and alerting for provider-reject patterns.
Oncall Bot: Monitoring for 30m post-restore; leave thread open for postmortem additions. :white_check_mark:
